recap: Jarrett Allen led the Cavaliers with 23 points (10-13 FG), 8 rebounds and 3 assists.
Kristaps Porzingis led the Wizards with 18 points (7-13 FG, 1-6 3PT), 7 rebounds and 1 assists.
CLE won 3 of 4 factors: shooting, second chances, getting to the line. Effective FG% 64.1 to 46.3.
Biggest swing: Donovan Mitchell makes 27-foot three point pullup running jump shot (Darius Garland assists) (Q1 11:24), +5 points of CLE win probability.

Bench points: CLE 19, WSH 38. Points in the paint: 58–38. Second-chance points: 6–11.
